releases.headline: Interface and navigation
releases.summary: Interface and navigation · Television experience · Library, subtitles and reliability · Verification and limitations
releases.brief: Refreshed Starlit screens. Samsung Tizen UI preview. Keep the existing library after connecting tracking accounts.

highlights.title: Refreshed Starlit screens
highlights.text: More consistent controls, spacing and visual hierarchy across Downloads, Library, collections, Sources, Settings, subtitle styling and watch-order screens.

highlights.title: Samsung Tizen UI preview
highlights.text: Redesigned TV navigation, search, sign-in, sources and display settings with visible remote-control focus, an on-screen keyboard, screen scaling and overscan adjustments.

highlights.title: Keep the existing library after connecting tracking accounts
highlights.text: Unset or invalid tracking-source preferences continue to use the local library rather than silently switching to an external provider.

releases.headline: Release packaging
releases.summary: Release packaging · Playback and audio · Accounts and platforms · Downloads, updates and library · Verification and limitations
releases.brief: Verified Windows native runtimes. Play privately. Trakt public-client OAuth.

highlights.title: Verified Windows native runtimes
highlights.text: Fetch the exact bundled libmpv and torrent runtime binaries from the release repository rather than depending on a separate repository's Git LFS bandwidth allowance.

highlights.title: Play privately
highlights.text: Start a single playback session without watch history, progress, account synchronization, or Trakt/Simkl scrobbles.

highlights.title: Trakt public-client OAuth
highlights.text: Use device authorization and PKCE without a bundled client secret.

releases.headline: Torrent playback and downloads
releases.summary: Torrent playback and downloads · Verification and limitations
releases.brief: Faster desktop torrent startup. More reliable tracker connections.

highlights.title: Faster desktop torrent startup
highlights.text: Apply the final cache, connection and upload settings before starting the bundled engine, avoiding redundant reconfiguration.

highlights.title: The P2P changes passed all 10 pull-request checks, including Windows P2P integration, Android Full, Play Store and TV builds/emulator, iOS Kotlin compilation, storage safety and public source…
More reliable tracker connections
highlights.text: Streaming and offline downloads use bounded UDP, HTTP and HTTPS fallback trackers alongside provider trackers without waiting on an unbounded remote tracker-list request.

releases.headline: Playback and desktop reliability
releases.summary: Playback and desktop reliability · Airing Now · Home, browsing and playback controls · Windows screen-share audio (experimental) · Download reliability · Verification and limitations
releases.brief: Reliable completion tracking. Find hidden titles quickly. Continue Watching organization.

highlights.title: Reliable completion tracking
highlights.text: Completed playback and external-player endings now report 100% progress to tracking integrations; a later partial stop event cannot overwrite a completed result.

highlights.title: Find hidden titles quickly
highlights.text: Search titles hidden from Recently released and browse them alphabetically on Android and desktop.

highlights.title: Continue Watching organization
highlights.text: Optionally group Continue Watching shelves by content type, with per-profile preferences and safeguards against stale resume updates.

releases.headline: Linux desktop
releases.brief: Starlit for Linux x86_64. Native desktop integration.

highlights.title: Starlit for Linux x86_64
highlights.text: Download a Debian/Ubuntu .deb, Fedora/RPM .rpm, portable .AppImage or sandboxed .flatpak from the same release page as Windows, Android phones and Android TV.

highlights.title: Linux installers currently target x86_64 and are distributed as GitHub Release downloads, not through configured APT/DNF repositories or Flathub.
Native desktop integration
highlights.text: Linux packages use the Starlit launcher and desktop entry, with a separate Flatpak application ID to avoid replacing a Nuvio installation.
